title: TunnelOpenResult
description: Result of the tunnel.open JSON-RPC method: the full record of the established forward. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

id.description: Backend-assigned tunnel id. The renderer echoes it to tunnel.stop; nothing else can stop a forward.

direction.description: Forwarding strategy. Only local (-L) is implemented; remote and dynamic land into this same record.

requestedBind.description: The bind the caller asked for. Port 0 means 'allocate' — the usable address is actualBind, never this.

host.description: Local bind host as requested; empty on the wire means the backend default 127.0.0.1.

port.description: Local bind port as requested. 0 means the OS allocated an ephemeral port (see actualBind).

actualBind.description: The address the listener really holds. Never the requested port when the request was 0 — reporting the request would be a lie.

port.description: The bound port. Always the real value from the OS; nonzero once state is running.

destination.description: Remote target of the forward, host:port, as dialed over the SSH connection.

scope.description: Owner label the renderer attached at open (tab id or profile id). The backend tears the forward down when the tab that opened it disconnects, not by this label.

caveat.description: Success-time bind caution, empty when none applies. Only remote (-R) forwards set it: the requested bind address is not verified — the server may have bound a different address (GatewayPorts) — so a URL built from this forward may only work on the server. Never an error: the forward is running.

state.description: Lifecycle state. open returns running (the bind happened before the result); stop returns stopped.

stopReason.description: Why the forward stopped: user, connection lost, or error. Null while running.

error.description: The error behind a stopped forward (bind failure, connection loss). Null while running or after a clean user stop.
